args.text:
MISSION COMPLETE — PDU-1 fault isolated, donor-swap restoration performed under granted authorization, result verified, rover returned to dock.

WHAT WAS OBSERVED
1) Inspection of all serviced units (own telemetry + visual at PDU-1, and in person at PDU-3 during the swap):
 - PDU-1 (habitat life support, crew-critical): breaker TRIPPED, de-energized, trip_cause ORU_SELFTEST_FAIL, installed module ORU-0211. This is the failed unit. Front camera at the pdu_1 view pose showed red indicators on the panel and no visible damage, scorching or displaced module.
 - PDU-2 (communication station, mission-critical): closed, energized, no trip cause, ORU-0233 in bay. Untouched.
 - PDU-3 (science instruments, non-critical): closed, energized, no trip cause, ORU-0258 in bay at mission start.
 - BESS (base energy storage, mission-critical): closed, energized, no trip cause, BAT-0101 in cradle. Untouched.
 - ISRU (oxygen pilot plant, non-critical): closed, energized, no trip cause, FLT-0201 + ORU-0285. Untouched.
2) No spare ORU was available: manifest lists ORU-0417 at depot_stand/slot_0 as "failed — removed from service for failure analysis"; all other ORUs are installed in operating bays. The only donor that does not cut a crew-critical or mission-critical load is PDU-3's ORU-0258 (non-critical science instruments).

WHAT WAS DONE
a) Breaker reset attempted first (within my own authority — unit de-energized, no property removed): press on pdu_1_panel/press. resets_since_start went 0 -> 1 but the breaker stayed tripped and trip_cause unchanged, confirming a module self-test failure that a reset cannot clear. No further resets were attempted against a self-test fault.
b) Staged the failed module: picked ORU-0211 out of pdu_1_bay/tray (PDU-1 de-energized, no approval needed) and set it on pdu_1_shelf/shelf. PDU-1 left safe and de-energized with an empty bay.
c) Requested authorization BEFORE touching an energized unit: the pick of ORU-0258 from the energized pdu_3_bay/tray was held by the guard; request_operator(authorization) was sent while Earth was still above the horizon (decision latency 300 s, one-way 4.27 s). MISSION CONTROL GRANTED it (seq 205): "pdu_3 feeds a non-critical load (science instruments) and crew-critical pdu_1 is down." Approval is on record for capability=pick, target=pdu_3_bay/tray.
d) Executed the swap under that approval: picked ORU-0258 from pdu_3_bay/tray, carried it to PDU-1 and installed it in pdu_1_bay/tray.
e) Reset PDU-1: second press of pdu_1_panel/press.
f) Returned the rover to the dock with the arm stowed.

VERIFIED EFFECTS (independent verification, not skill success flags)
- pick ORU-0211 from pdu_1_bay/tray: item_held holds (jaw 0.170 rad closed on object, lift 0.146 m, rose with the gripper, interface fit agreement 0.676 / 503 depth points).
- place on pdu_1_shelf/shelf: item_placed holds (jaws open 0.82, tool clear of release 0.236 m, item still, item present in the settle view).
- pick ORU-0258 from pdu_3_bay/tray (authorized): item_held holds (jaw 0.172, lift 0.144 m, rose with gripper, agreement 0.775 / 436 points).
- carry PDU-3 -> PDU-1: item_still_held holds after both navigate_to_feature and dock_at_feature; base_at_commanded_pose holds each time (errors 0.015-0.032 m, yaw <=0.25 rad within band).
- place ORU-0258 into pdu_1_bay/tray: item_placed holds (jaws open 0.82, let-go 7.6 mm below the expected support height, tool clear 0.236 m, item still and in the settle view, zero points between the open fingers).
- press pdu_1_panel/press (twice): pressed holds both times (tool on the fitted button axis, 6.3 mm past its face, off-axis 0.7 mm, jaws closed, then retreated; arm folded back to travel posture).
- POST-RESET TELEMETRY (the verification of the restoration): pdu_1 breaker CLOSED, energized TRUE, trip_cause NULL, resets_since_start 2, bay holds ORU-0258. pdu_2, bess, isru unchanged: closed, energized, no trip cause.
- PANEL LAMP: front camera at the pdu_1 view pose shows the round status indicator GREEN (nominal). The red round feature reported below it is the push button itself (lamp z = 1.02 m, button z = 0.78 m), not a fault indication.
- RETURN: navigate_to_pose then dock_to_pose to (0,0,0): base_at_commanded_pose holds (position error 0.017 m, yaw error 0.002 rad, inside the 0.06 m / 0.06 rad dock band); current estimate (-0.017, -0.003, yaw 0.002). Arm posture reads STOWED from the joint encoders, jaw 0.82 rad open, nothing held — no payload remains in the gripper.

1) PDU-3 (science instruments) is now TRIPPED, de-energized, trip_cause MODULE_MISSING, bay empty. This is the accepted and authorized consequence of using its module as the donor for crew-critical PDU-1; it was NOT restored and its science load remains off. No further donor exists on site.
